subject.title: feat(firecrawl): add keyless Firecrawl Search (Free) provider + richer firecrawl_search options

question: Should OpenClaw publish `firecrawl-free` as an official opt-in hosted no-auth web_search provider despite the privacy/support boundary and mixed upstream API documentation?
rationale: The code can preserve key isolation, but only maintainers can decide whether sending opted-in search queries to Firecrawl's free hosted tier is acceptable product and security policy for an official provider id.

options.title: Accept the opt-in provider
options.body: Merge the two-provider shape after owner review, treating Firecrawl's keyless tier as an explicit user-selected hosted search destination.

options.title: Defer the provider id
options.body: Keep the richer keyed `firecrawl_search` options but postpone `firecrawl-free` until Firecrawl's no-auth search contract is documented consistently or sponsored by maintainers.

options.title: Keep search credentialed
options.body: Close or pause this direction if official OpenClaw Firecrawl search should require a configured key even when upstream offers a fallback tier.

recommendation.title: Accept the opt-in provider
recommendation.body: Merge the two-provider shape after owner review, treating Firecrawl's keyless tier as an explicit user-selected hosted search destination.

likelyOwner.reason: They merged the narrowed keyless Firecrawl scrape boundary and are the strongest recent history owner for deciding whether to extend that boundary to search.
